authority_2_name: Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives

authority_3_name: UN Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division (World Population Prospects)
authority_rationale: This is a historical national population figure for 1960, so Nigeria's census and statistics bodies and the UN body that publishes its own historical population series are the first-hand sources.
notes: The claim states the figure as a fact, not as a quoted statement, so the data producers come first. The State House (statehouse.gov.ng) is first-hand only for whether Buhari said it in his Independence Day speech of 1 October 2020; it was left out to stay within 3 authorities. The World Bank (data.worldbank.org) also publishes a historical population series (WDI) and is an alternative to authority 3. No national census was held exactly in 1960 (there were censuses in 1952/53 and 1962/63), so the national bodies may hold only estimates. The NPC domain is given from memory: population.gov.ng is the one I am most confident about.

The underlying incident data came from START's Global Terrorism Database (University of Maryland, start.umd.edu), a possible secondary primary that was not listed.
